scope: Re-attestation of the R1 companion saved sources after an automated consumer save overwrote the 2026-07-29 attested SMC Event Overlay source. Measurement only: no publication, no alert creation or modification, no Railway mutation, no layout-preset change.
supersessionNote: The 2026-07-29 artifact remains checked in and unmodified. It is a dated measurement of the state on that day and stays true of that day; it is superseded as the CURRENT attestation, not corrected.

reattestationTrigger.reason: smc-library-refresh bumped the Event Overlay micro-profile import from /179 to /182 (#4284) and the chained consumer save pushed the new source to TradingView, so the source attested on 2026-07-29 no longer existed live.
reattestationTrigger.sourceDiffCharacter: library pin 179 -> 182, continuation-line reindent (CE10156 class), and one status-line change replacing a single dynamic plotchar with five static ones because Pine requires plotchar.char to be a const string. Display surface only: no alert, no plot consumed by another script, no trade logic.
reattestationTrigger.gateThatDidNotFire: scripts/check_r1_attested_sources.py (#4286) blocks a PULL REQUEST that un-attests a source. The overwrite reached TradingView through a workflow_dispatch of tv-save-consumer-source, which no gate observes.

SMC Event Overlay.compileEvidenceMechanism: saveConsumerSource awaits waitForPostSaveCompileSettlement and then assertNoVisibleCompileError (scripts/tv_save_consumer_source.ts:142-144). The check is enforced by throwing, so it is proven by the save entry reporting ok rather than recorded as its own field.

SMC Exit Signal.compileEvidenceMechanism: saveConsumerSource awaits waitForPostSaveCompileSettlement and then assertNoVisibleCompileError (scripts/tv_save_consumer_source.ts:142-144). The check is enforced by throwing, so it is proven by the save entry reporting ok rather than recorded as its own field.

tradingView.suitePresenceEvidence: Every BUS input resolved to a 'SMC Long-Dip Suite: <label>' parent with zero unknown-parent runtime errors. No direct chart-inventory scan of the producer was run, so the Suite's presence is inferred from live parent resolution rather than counted.
tradingView.alertMutationEvidence: None of the executed scripts (tv_batch_consumer_rollout.ts, tv_save_consumer_source.ts, tv_verify_consumer_bindings.ts) contains any alert creation, modification, or removal path.
tradingView.layoutSaveNote: No binding was changed on this layout, so no layout save was requested or performed (mutations.layoutSaveRequested false in both runs). The bindings were already correct.

rollback.reason: The 2026-07-29 rollback drill (remove both companions, reload, verify Suite-only, restore from the saved scripts, re-establish ten bindings, final reload) has no implementation in this repository. Running it would mean improvising the sequence against the live account, and re-inserting a chart instance restores it with DEFAULT inputs, which would drop the ten bindings that are currently correct.
rollback.notTheSameAs: The controlled repair E2E run on 2026-08-01 (run 30685141166) is a different drill on a different chart: it drifts one binding of SMC Decision Board on the primary operator layout vWgAWyfC and proves the repair survives a reload. It exercises the repair machinery, not the R1 companion rollback.

replay.justification: The replay evidence covers SMC Exit Signal, whose source SHA-256 is byte-identical to the 2026-07-29 attested value (82136e25457f2d0cc9754b84a410f01f6b880b2500624001d297e4ced3b5076c). The 2026-08-01 drift is confined to SMC Event Overlay. Nothing the replay measured changed, so re-running it would produce the same cases against the same source.

openGates: Hold Manager exclusivity and Simple Management layout inventory
chart-instance compile status after a final reload
rollback drill removing and restoring both companions
limitations: No TradingView alert was created, changed, enabled, or disabled.
No Railway service, variable, deployment, or secret was changed.
No layout was saved; no binding was repaired or rebound on the R1 layout.

The four open gates above were NOT measured on 2026-08-01. The 2026-07-29 artifact recorded them from operator observation during an attended session; nothing in this run reproduces them, and they are listed as open rather than carried over.
The producer's presence on the R1 layout is inferred from resolved BUS parents, not counted by an inventory scan.
